links.outcome: ChatGPT HAMD-21 scoring reliability versus expert raters and script-based reference scores
links.effect: Total-score ICC 0.9739 (ChatGPT) vs 0.9921 (experts); experts perfect ICC on 11 items vs ChatGPT on 2; experts significantly better on 10 items and total (Z=1.931, p=0.0268).
links.quote: Steiger's test demonstrated that experts significantly outperformed ChatGPT on 10 individual items as well as on total scores (Z = 1.931, p = 0.0268).

links.outcome: ChatGPT arithmetic accuracy when calculating HAMD-21 total scores
links.effect: ChatGPT frequently miscalculated total scores; also overestimated insomnia and somatic items (4-6, 13).
links.quote: Qualitative review revealed that ChatGPT tended to overestimate scores on items related to insomnia and somatic symptoms (items 4-6 and 13) and frequently miscalculated total scores.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of ChatGPT-4o in scoring HAMD-21 assessments using standardized patient transcripts compared to expert raters, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
